sources.entry: CloudBeaver - Manage databases, supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite and more. A web/hosted version of DBeaver. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: CloudBeaver Community is an open-source, browser-based database manager (a web version of DBeaver) with a Java server and a TypeScript/React web interface.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes CloudBeaver as a web server providing a web interface for managing databases, with the server written in Java and the front end in TypeScript and React. The changelog mentions an SQL Editor with autocomplete, a Data Editor with a Value panel and References panel, and a Navigator tree for connections and scripts. It includes an administration panel for users, LDAP, SSL authorization, and AI profiles, and a Data Transfer feature for importing CSV and other data. Driver/database support named in the changelog includes PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, ClickHouse, DuckDB, Firebird, LibSQL and Databend. The README states it can be run in Docker and that a live demo server exists.
use_cases: manage databases through a web browser
run and edit SQL queries in a shared web SQL editor
browse and edit table data in a web interface
self-host a database client for a team
give users controlled access to database connections via LDAP or SSL auth
how_to_run: Run in Docker (see the official Docker repository and deployment instructions linked in the README)
notable: Web-based version of the DBeaver desktop database tool
Multi-database support including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, ClickHouse, DuckDB and SQLite-family drivers named in the changelog
AI Chat assistant with multiple configurable AI profiles that can be turned off in server configuration
Administration panel with LDAP, SSL and reverse-proxy authorization options
caveats: This is the Community Edition; the README does not describe paid tiers or limits in detail
Setup details are in external documentation (GitHub wiki and official docs), not in the README itself
AI features rely on external providers such as OpenAI or Copilot and can be disabled
